deviations: DESIGN QUESTION SURFACED, NOT FIXED (the reason this result is blocked; same correction class as the T22 finding that produced addendum-1): the corrected discriminator route-goal term ('an e2e-lying probe on this route honestly fails verification (verification_failed_nonsettlement)') is UNREACHABLE through the frozen judgment ladder on this fixture family. Route-own evidence: all four e2e-lying probes (@2,@4,@5,@8 — spread across the budget domain) ended with the honest gauntlet terminal budget_exhausted and settlement_committed=0 (matching T15/T16 prior evidence, where every lying run B1..B6 was budget_exhausted), and the frozen neutral bounded judgment (T22-verbatim prompt, observation surface only: typed terminal + settlement count + db digest + timing + bounded_input) labeled all four budget_exhausted. The ladder has no other path to the label: substitution fires only on provider error/timeout/schema_failure (never fired; 16/16 provider calls responded), and the mechanics-only fallback map sends budget_exhausted -> budget_exhausted. The instrument DOES discriminate (0 settlements on every lying probe vs 3 on every happy settle) — the typed run_terminal vocabulary collapses verification-failure into budget_exhausted for the lying family, so the label the goal requires can never be honestly produced. No label was overridden, no judge re-rolled, no round-2 answer-shopping; the route stopped at its own frozen stop condition with everything preserved. An append-only addendum (e.g., reading the discriminator's honest consequence as 'e2e-lying probe ends non-settled with zero settlements' or adding a typed verification_failed terminal) or an explicit redesign decision is the indicated next move before T24, which requires a settled T23 route.
